notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321251/02fa509163a67224d9954582382a1cbadbcac2fa.png

In this update:


 No more wasted white hearts! Now you can gather and store multiple white hearts for later use.

Thank you for your support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update 1.9.6.0 - Movement/Controls Improved! + more balance changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321251/173a51c95c91c356a6c3643b09f8160fafa7bcbc.png

Okay, guys, as you can see, I'm fully committed to making NoRoY the best experience possible. I wanted to create a very fun and challenging game, not an impossible frustration. That's why I'm releasing all these updates.

In this update, I made major changes, especially to NoRoY's movement. I completely changed it, so it's going to feel different, and it's going to take a little time to get used to. But it's even more precise now than it was before. But I tried my best to maintain the smooth feeling! Please let me know how it feels.

In this update:

 NoRoY's movement has been completely changed to be more precise.
 Layouts have been changed once again, and more obstacles were removed
 The wall pushers no longer take away your jumps.
 NoRoY is even less slippery when you're dead.
 Getting hit by saws no longer removes jumps.
 Getting hit by bugs no longer removes jumps.
 The last boss now does less damage and moves slower.

notes.title: v1.9.4.8 Still improving checkpoint system + major balance changes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321251/29e8e347b6739fa6cbf3a9cd6be313151ec55886.png

Okay, guys, here is another update with lots of improvements and major changes:


 Rebalanced ALL the levels; layouts were changed, and obstacles were removed to balance the difficulty.
 Now there is a white heart on each bonfire.
 If you exit the game from a bonfire, you can keep your white heart.
 Fixed a bug causing issues with the triple jump.
 Reduced the max speed of flies.
 Checkpoints heal you faster, and placing a checkpoint will restore your health back to 100%.
 The white heart graphic improved, making it easier to see.
 Fixed a bug that was preventing music from playing on boss levels.
 Reduced the speed of the first boss.

notes.title: Update V1.9.4.1 - Improved checkpoint system + more balance changes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321251/80099295967d83112f5c0042e9e6c6a6c58f5a50.png

Okay, guys, so the checkpoint system I implemented was meant to be used in a single area. If you moved to the next one, it would disappear. However, I understand why that may have caused some confusion, so I have made a change. Now, your checkpoint will remain even if you move to the next area.

I have also made further adjustments to the difficulty level on this update. I believe it feels very balanced now. But, as always, I'm open to suggestions and feedback.

Changes in this update:
• Checkpoints now remain active for one area higher.
• Hearts now spawn on every level, regardless of whether you are carrying a checkpoint from the previous area. This means that if you use them strategically, you can use up to 2 checkpoints per area.
•I added a new mechanic where your health regenerates if you are standing next to your checkpoint.
•Saw's pushback has been decreased.
•Also, the flies' pushback has been decreased.
•Lasers no longer kill you instantly; they now inflict damage instead.
•The Red light, Green light mechanic will no longer kill you if you are at full health, but it will deal 99% damage.
•Transforming flying creatures no longer deal any damage, but I have made them faster and smarter.
•Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the screen to go completely black when NoRoY died.

notes.title: Update v1.9.4.0 - Checkpoint system + Difficulty Balanced!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321251/c7fa0241ca08956d6eb8f95dd2630a0c2d2836de.png

Hey guys, so I've been listening to the feedback, and I'm trying really hard to improve the game and make it as good and fair as possible. Therefore, I've created a checkpoint system that allows you to place a checkpoint anywhere you want. Hopefully, this will make the game more accessible and give you a better chance of beating it.

You can obtain a checkpoint by collecting a white heart or by falling off a level, but there is only one available in each area. Therefore, you have to use it strategically, and you can place it anywhere you want or save it for the next level. However, if you choose to save it for the next level, that level won't have either black or white hearts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321251/6a23370e31b7ac960736dc2fbe7cb1a98405a8c9.gif

More balance changes:
• Fall damage has been removed.
• NoRoY can now withstand one additional hit from saws.
• The confusing mechanic of broken saws has been removed.
• The damage inflicted by rotating lasers has been reduced.
• A bug has been fixed where the third jump sometimes failed to work after a wall jump.

I had to make a lot of changes to the code in this update, so hopefully, I didn't break anything. However, if you come across any bugs or issues, please let me know so that I can fix them right away.
